name: bax-bench-sec-code-pairs
description: A dataset of paired insecure and secure code snippets intended to evaluate models on security-focused code tasks such as vulnerability detection and patching. It measures an LLM's ability to identify insecure constructs and produce correct, secure repairs or secure alternative implementations. The pairs are used for both classification of vulnerabilities and generation of fixed code.
reputation: Niche, researcher-contributed dataset on Hugging Face with limited community adoption outside security-focused code-research groups.
